notes.title: Release date + new gameplay trailer revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone, we’ve got some big news to share today as we finally reveal that [b]Tormented Souls 2 [/b]will launch on [b]23rd October 2025![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]To celebrate the rapidly-approaching release of our chilling throwback to classic survival horror, we’ve partnered with the [b]Future Games Show at Gamescom 2025[/b] to showcase a pulse-pounding [b]new gameplay trailer[/b], and reveal first details of the [b]monstrous bosses [/b]that Caroline will encounter while exploring the hellish[b] ‘Other side[/b]’ of Villa Hess.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/8130011b6809b1f4e03959fedfd11c99c204c303.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]⚠️⚠️WARNING! Spoilers for Tormented Souls ahead! ⚠️⚠️[/p][h3]
[b]Check out the ‘A New Nightmare’ Gameplay Trailer as seen in the Future Games Show Gamescom Showcase![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="2tW08Oy7QmY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In the wake of her sister [b]Anna’s[/b] traumatic abduction at the hands of [b]Mother Lucia [/b]and her twisted cult, [b]Caroline Walker[/b] finds herself trapped deep within the walls of a maze-like convent. With the darkness closing in, Caroline is unexpectedly reacquainted with her old friend, the pneumatic nailer, and so begins a desperate struggle to escape the unholy place. But once free of the convent, the true horror of the secluded [b]Villa Hess[/b] reveals itself and Caroline must again [b]call upon her supernatural abilities[/b] to travel to the town’s mysterious [b]‘Other side’[/b] and face the formidable creatures that await within…[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Switching realities[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/ce51573734c5757f933c3717242bf470475956ce.gif"][/img][/p][p]In the original [b]Tormented Souls[/b] it was Caroline’s latent supernatural powers that allowed her to[b] utilise mirrors and video tapes[/b] to traverse between [b]alternate realities[/b] and [b]timelines[/b] to ultimately save Anna from her cruel fate. [/p][p] In [b]Tormented Souls 2[/b], Caroline will continue to embrace these powers as she steps into Villa Hess’ mysterious ‘Other side’ and ‘replays’ memories stored on video tapes. Crucially Caroline’s actions in these locations will directly affect the current timeline in Villa Hess, while revealing more about the town’s dark history.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The horrors of the ‘Other side’[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Only the [b]foulest and most dangerous creatures[/b] reside within the ‘Other side’ and Caroline must be extra vigilant when exploring this twisted new reality. Deadliest of all are[b] beings of immense power[/b] that have gorged on the misery and corruption that envelops the region. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/2b84dd25ebd3bb1d8b6f349903891dfc5ee8c85d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Wielding a huge crucifix and protected by a heavy plated mask, the [b]Iron Maiden[/b] is a hulking behemoth and cruel disciplinarian who administers punishment amongst the convent’s sisterhood.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/ebae69e4daf50e15406e4fdf7dcfa12b1d879c97.png"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, deep beneath the stinking halls of the [b]Wildberger & Hess Fish Processing Plant[/b] sleeps [b]The Harvester[/b], a terrifying fusion of twisted metal and scorched flesh. Armed with a lethal buzzsaw and gaping maw filled with razor sharp teeth, this subterranean horror seems impervious to all but the heaviest of weapons. [/p][p][/p][p]Until next time! [/p][p]Dual Effect & PQube[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo update 1.0.2 is now live!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi all![/h3][p][/p][p]We’re just checking in to give you a quick update on the Steam demo version of [b]Tormented Souls 2. [/b]Since launching a few weeks back over 27,000 players have now experienced this special demo edition, which is truly staggering! Naturally with so many of you playing, we’ve received A LOT of feedback which we have been reviewing and discussing as a team. [/p][p][/p][p]Today, we’re releasing the 1.0.2 patch for the demo which addresses several of the bigger pain points that the community has raised, please read on for a full list of what we have changed.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Improvements[/b][/u][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added Type C control scheme.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Anna's character model. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased radius size of interaction points. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the animation of the lighter being equipped when coming off a ladder. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with physics on the elevator.[/p][/*][*][p]Several fixes to facial animations. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved melee weapon system on breakable objects. [/p][/*][*][p]Removed collision from breakable objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added breakables on staircase at Belltower to decrease backtracking. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a new hint for the Cryptex puzzle. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated cable colour for electrical panel in Prison[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned puzzle for electrical panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to pick up the electrical panel puzzle hint. [/p][/*][*][p]Added zoom in/out feature on Map for Controller [/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance throughout. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Bug fixes[/u] [/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where occasionally players would get into a softlock when dashing with Hammer and switching instantly to the Nailer. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Cryptex puzzle where the mesh would separate from the puzzle. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players will be stuck in auto aiming when switching from the Lighter to the Nailer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with corrupted map in Jailer room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could attack an enemy before the jump scare. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the shortcut menu will not work when coming off a ladder. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when loading auto save in Basement and then entering South Corridor 1F[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with FPS dropping when opening the Map.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the feedback and support, we’ll endeavour to address as much as possible before the final release this year, and we’ll be back with more updates over the coming months. [/p][p][/p][p]Dual Effect and PQube.[/p][p]
[/p]
